say:2:1220362001:1.text: Tucker! How are you? We heard Sonja got you a new job.
say:2:1220362001:1.source_cn: 塔克！你还好吗？听说索尼娅给你安排了新的工作。

say:3:1220362002:1.text: Well, actually, Lucca found out what had happened and asked the boss to assign me this job.
say:3:1220362002:1.source_cn: 其实是卢卡二当家得知了事情的经过，他去拜托大当家给我安...

say:4:1220362003:1.text: The boss wants to protect the orphans wandering around Rustport. She's setting up an orphanage, and I'm helping.
say:4:1220362003:1.source_cn: 大当家想要好好保护在锈锚港流浪的孩子，她正在筹办孤儿院...

say:5:1220362004:1.text: Wow! Did you make this whole pot of stew? It smells delicious.
say:5:1220362004:1.source_cn: 哇，这一大锅都是你做的？看着不错嘛。

say:6:1220362005:1.text: Actually, my cooking is average, but luckily, these children aren't picky eaters.
say:6:1220362005:1.source_cn: 其实我的手艺不怎么样，幸好这些孩子不挑食。

say:7:1220362006:0.text: So the place behind you will become an orphanage in the future?
say:7:1220362006:0.source_cn: 你身后这地方，以后就是孤儿院了吗？

say:8:1220362007:1.text: The location hasn't been decided yet, so the children are living in tents for the time being. Just having a place to live is not enough. They have to find a way to support themselves.
say:8:1220362007:1.source_cn: 孤儿院的选址还没定，孩子们暂时只能住在帐篷里。光是有个...

say:9:1220362008:1.text: So, in addition to cooking for them, the boss asked me to teach them how to survive.
say:9:1220362008:1.source_cn: 除了给他们做饭，大当家还让我教他们一些生存技巧。

say:10:1220362009:0.text: As long as they can survive on their own, when they grow up, they'll be able to make something of themselves.
say:10:1220362009:0.source_cn: 只要能够靠自己生活下去，等他们长大，也就不再是海中漂泊...

say:13:1220362010:1.text: You seem to like children very much. I know you have a daughter. Have you ever thought about going back to see her?
say:13:1220362010:1.source_cn: 你好像很喜欢小孩子。我知道你有一个女儿，你想过回去见她吗？

say:14:1220362011:1.text: I-I'm too ashamed to see her. At least, I'm not ready yet.
say:14:1220362011:1.source_cn: 我……我没脸见她。起码现在还没有。

say:15:1220362012:1.text: Now, as I spend every day with these kids, I feel somewhat proud of what I do.
say:15:1220362012:1.source_cn: 现在每天和孩子们相处，我感觉自己的腰杆一点点直了起来。

say:16:1220362013:0.text: Maybe in a few years, I'll have the courage to go back and see Lily.
say:16:1220362013:0.source_cn: 说不定，在很多年以后，我会有勇气回去见莉莉。

say:17:1220362014:1.text: When I see her, I'll definitely tell her about the girl I met here...
say:17:1220362014:1.source_cn: 见到莉莉，我一定又会想起那个小姑娘吧……

say:18:1220362015:1.text: She has gone to a better place. You should live a good life so she doesn't worry about you.
say:18:1220362015:1.source_cn: 她一定去了很美的地方，你也要好好生活，别让她担心。

say:20:1220362017:0.text: By the way, it's so sunny today.
say:20:1220362017:0.source_cn: 话说回来……今天的太阳很暖和啊。

say:21:1220362018:1.text: I hope that girl is somewhere safe enjoying the nice, warm sunshine...
say:21:1220362018:1.source_cn: 也不知道她现在能不能享受到这份阳光？要是能……那就太好了。
